title: PerfomanceMatters
description: Sacrifice every aspect of quality to boost your perfomance
body:
This mod sacrifices every aspect of quality to max out your perfomance.

it features:
- one pixel items and textures
- no rain/snow
- no particles
- no main menu background
- some other minor fixes

recommended with:
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
- [Ferrite Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)

This mod is intended as a joke, the gameplay might not be the most pleasing.

WARNING: it will reset your quality settings.
